body:
Connect with your Blue Lace Agate Touchstone when you need to relax. This cool blue crystal provides portable comfort as you navigate through your day to day stresses. Hold your Blue Lace Agate Touchstone in your hand to calm your spirit, no matter what else is going on. Carrying this stone in your pocket or purse ensures that whether you're stuck in traffic, having a chaotic day at work or having an issue with someone in your life, you can still find a source of peace within by connecting with Blue Lace Agate.

If stress makes it hard for you to communicate, Blue Lace Agate energy is the perfect remedy. It alleviates any tension that your spirit is holding in your throat, and allows your thoughts and feelings to flow through. This enables you to ask for help when you need it, or simply handle your stress a graceful and articulate way.

Since the family mine that owned and operated the only known source of Blue Lace Agate was closed in 2017, all Blue Lace Agate specimen are increasingly rare.

When you're feeling drawn to a Blue Lace Agate Touchstone, your spirit is calling out for tranquility. If you've been feeling overwhelmed by stress, then Blue Lace Agate is the cooling energy you need to temper heated or chaotic emotions.

Namibia
